1st-quarter and first-3-minute props" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="135" width="280" x="1300" y="214" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#4ecdc4;dashed=1;fontColor=#1f3a60;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="Legend
3-line fork = many, single bar = one
PK = primary key, FK = links to another table
UQ = unique (no two rows may repeat it)
UQ* = unique among opening lines
UQ† = unique among live / closing lines
Dashed box = view (no rows of its own)
league is 'nba' or 'wnba', never defaulted

div.div:
Legend
3-line fork = many, single bar = one
PK = primary key, FK = links to another table
UQ = unique (no two rows may repeat it)
UQ* = unique among opening lines
UQ† = unique among live / closing lines
Dashed box = view (no rows of its own)
league is 'nba' or 'wnba', never defaulted
m = made, a = attempted, pct = made ÷ attempted
oreb / dreb = offensive / defensive rebounds
Orange border = 004_read_layer, 005_bdl_pit, or a planned rule

div.div:
predictions rules (triggers in 004)
One row per model run; UPDATE and DELETE are refused
predicted_at = DB insert time; a writer's value is ignored
Refused when predicted_at >= games.datetime_utc
or when the game has no datetime_utc
Every column NOT NULL except distribution (JSON object)
double / triple double: value is a probability (0 to 1)
distribution is read only by Python, per model_version
No line, book or odds: the model never reads prop odds
Grade: join prop_actuals (league, game, player, market)
Also index (league, bdl_player_id, market, predicted_at)

div.div:
ML dataset module (Python; planned, not in 004)
One training row = one player_game_stats row
Label = prop_actuals.actual_value, one target per market
Read each source only up to T, the prediction time:
· player_game_stats, games: games before the target game
· game_odds_snapshots: opening rows, median across books
· projected_lineups: newest with first_seen_at <= T
· injury_snapshots: latest with snapshot_at <= T
· player_prop_snapshots: never a feature
Any source not listed is refused
Stand-ins, known only after tip-off:
· game_lineups.starter in place of projected starters
· box-score absence in place of injury reports
Output column info_source = pregame or standin
(standin when the row used any stand-in)
Final scores count only info_source = pregame rows

switch.text: ML dataset module (Python; planned, not in 004)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 159, 67), rgb(159, 77, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 368px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1371px; margin-left: 1681px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1f3a60;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1f3a60, #a9c0e0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Teammate absence (dataset module; planned)
Rotation players of team T, from games before the target:
· latest game before the target was for T (trades drop)
· played ≥ 3 of T's last 10 games, averaging ≥ 15 min
team_absences(league, team, game, as_of, source)
returns (bdl_player_id, p_out) per absent rotation player
· actual: no row, or dnp, in the target game → p_out 1
· reported: latest listed injury row with snapshot_at ≤ T
p_out by status, starting at Out 1 · Doubtful .75
Questionable .5 · Day-To-Day .25 · Probable .1
refit later from how often each status sat out
Features = Σ p_out × the teammate's recent value:
· team_missing_minutes: average minutes
· team_missing_share: share of the team's market stat
· opp_missing_minutes: the same for the opponent
Own injury status: reported rows only, NULL before
The same function builds training rows and live inputs

div.div:
injury_snapshots.status writer rule
Store BDL's word; Doubtful stays Doubtful
Spelling only: DAY_TO_DAY → Day-To-Day
Unknown words: kept as sent, trimmed
Blank: NULL, never guessed
Redis injuries:nba:latest also keeps
Doubtful (own PR, supersedes SPO-135h)
